native.query:
select to_char(p2.report_date, 'MM.YYYY') as month_year,
	sum(p2.day_profit) as day_profit
	--,
--	sum(p2.day_profit_usd) as day_profit_usd,
--	sum(p2.profit_month_to_date) as profit_mtd,
--	sum(p2.profit_month_to_date_usd) as profit_mtd_usd,
--	sum(p2.profit_year_to_date) as profit_ytd,
--	sum(p2.profit_year_to_date_usd) as profit_ytd_usd
from replset.mv_everyday_profit_mtd_ytd_by_stores_cat p2
where p2.report_date >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE)
group by to_char(p2.report_date, 'MM.YYYY')
order by to_char(p2.report_date, 'MM.YYYY')

select to_char(p2.report_date, 'MM.YYYY') as month_year,
--	sum(p2.day_profit) as day_profit
	--,
	sum(p2.day_profit_usd) as day_profit_usd
	--,
--	sum(p2.profit_month_to_date) as profit_mtd,
--	sum(p2.profit_month_to_date_usd) as profit_mtd_usd,
--	sum(p2.profit_year_to_date) as profit_ytd,
--	sum(p2.profit_year_to_date_usd) as profit_ytd_usd
from replset.mv_everyday_profit_mtd_ytd_by_stores_cat p2
where p2.report_date >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE)
group by to_char(p2.report_date, 'MM.YYYY')
order by to_char(p2.report_date, 'MM.YYYY')

select b.month_year, b.month_budget, p.month_profit 
from ( 
	select to_char(b2.budget_date, 'MM.YYYY') as month_year,
		sum(b2.budget_value) as month_budget
	from replset.mv_everyday_budget_mtd_ytd_by_stores b2
	where b2.budget_date > to_date('31.12.2024', 'DD.MM.YYYY')
	group by to_char(b2.budget_date, 'MM.YYYY')
	) b
left join ( 	
	select to_char(p2.report_date, 'MM.YYYY') as month_year,
		sum(p2.day_profit) as month_profit
    from replset.mv_everyday_profit_mtd_ytd_by_stores_cat p2
    where p2.report_date >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE)
    group by to_char(p2.report_date, 'MM.YYYY')
) p
on b.month_year = p.month_year 
order by b.month_year

select b.month_year, b.shop_name, (p.month_profit - b.month_budget) / b.month_budget * 100 as month_deviation 
from ( 
	select to_char(b2.budget_date, 'MM.YYYY') as month_year,
		b2.shop_name,
		sum(b2.budget_value) as month_budget
	from replset.mv_everyday_budget_mtd_ytd_by_stores b2
	where b2.budget_date > to_date('31.12.2024', 'DD.MM.YYYY')
	group by to_char(b2.budget_date, 'MM.YYYY'), b2.shop_name
	) b
left join ( 	
	select p.month_year, p.shop_name, p.month_profit
	from ( 
		select to_char(p2.report_date, 'MM.YYYY') as month_year,
			p2.shop_name,
			sum(p2.day_profit) as month_profit
		from replset.mv_everyday_profit_mtd_ytd_by_stores_cat p2
		group by to_char(p2.report_date, 'MM.YYYY'), p2.shop_name
		) p
	) p
on b.month_year = p.month_year and b.shop_name = p.shop_name 
order by b.month_year

select p2.report_date, 
	--    p2.shop_name,
		sum(p2.day_profit) as day_profit,
		sum(p2.budget_value) as day_budget
    from replset.mv_combined_all_stores_data p2
    where --p2.report_date between '2025-09-01' and '2025-09-30' 
		p2.report_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date)
        and p2.report_date < date_trunc('month', current_date) + interval '1 month'

select shop_name as "Магазин",
 TO_CHAR((sum(profit_year_to_date) -  sum(ytd_prev_year)) / sum(nullif(ytd_prev_year, 0)) * 100, 'FM990.00%') AS "Рост выручки YTD, %",
 TO_CHAR((sum(profit_year_to_date) - sum(ytd_budget)) / sum(ytd_budget) * 100, 'FM990.00%') AS "Отклонение от Бюджета, %",
 TO_CHAR((sum(ytd_receipts) - sum(ytd_receipts_prev_year)) / sum(ytd_receipts_prev_year) * 100, 'FM990.00%') AS "Рост транзакций YTD, %",
 REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(TO_CHAR(sum(profit_year_to_date)/(SUM(ytd_receipts)), '999G999G999G999')),'.', ' '),',',' '),' ', ' ') || ' ₸' AS "Средний чек YTD, KZT",
 REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(TO_CHAR(sum(profit_year_to_date_usd)/SUM(ytd_receipts), '999G999.99')),' ',' '),',',' '),' ',' ') || ' $' AS "Средний Чек YTD, USD",
 REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(TO_CHAR(sum(profit_year_to_date), '999G999G999G999')),'.', ' '),',', ' '),' ', ' ') || ' ₸' AS "Выручка,KZT"
from replset.mv_combined_all_stores_data
where {{actual_date}} 
group by shop_name

select 
TO_CHAR((sum(profit_year_to_date) -  sum(ytd_prev_year)) / sum(nullif(ytd_prev_year, 0)) * 100, 'FM990.00%') AS "Рост выручки YTD, %"
from replset.mv_combined_all_stores_data
where {{actual_date}}
--c.report_date = '2025-10-10'::date
group by report_date

select TO_CHAR((sum(profit_month_to_date) -  sum(mtd_prev_year)) / sum(nullif(mtd_prev_year, 0)) * 100, 'FM990.00%') AS "Рост выручки MTD, %"
from replset.mv_combined_all_stores_data
where {{actual_date}}
--c.report_date = '2025-10-10'::date
group by report_date

select TO_CHAR((sum(day_profit) -  sum(day_profit_prev_year)) / sum(nullif(day_profit_prev_year, 0)) * 100, 'FM990.00%') AS "Рост выручки за день, %"
from replset.mv_combined_all_stores_data
where {{actual_date}}
--c.report_date = '2025-10-10'::date
group by report_date

select p.main_cat,
	   TO_CHAR(	   
	   (sum(p.profit_year_to_date)-
	   sum(p.ytd_prev_year)) /
   	   nullif(sum(p.ytd_prev_year),0)
   	   * 100, 'FM999 990.00%') AS "Рост выручки YTD, %",
	   TO_CHAR(	   
	   (sum(p.profit_month_to_date) - 
	   sum(p.mtd_prev_year)) /
	   nullif(sum(p.mtd_prev_year),0)
	    * 100, 'FM999 990.00%') AS "Рост выручки MTD, %",
	   TO_CHAR(	   
	   (sum(p.day_profit) -
	   sum(p.day_profit_prev_year)) /
	   nullif(sum(p.day_profit_prev_year),0) 
   	    * 100, 'FM999 990.00%') AS "Дневн Рост выручки, %",
   	    -- 1. Доля прибыли YTD (Year-to-Date)
    TO_CHAR(
        (SUM(p.profit_year_to_date) * 100.0) /
        NULLIF(SUM(SUM(p.profit_year_to_date)) OVER (), 0),
        'FM990.00%') AS "Доля прибыли YTD, %",
    -- 2. Доля прибыли MTD (Month-to-Date)
    TO_CHAR(
        (SUM(p.profit_month_to_date) * 100.0) /
        NULLIF(SUM(SUM(p.profit_month_to_date)) OVER (), 0),
        'FM990.00%') AS "Доля прибыли MTD, %" 
from replset.mv_combined_all_stores_data p
where report_date = '2025-10-10'
group by p.report_date,
	   p.main_cat

card.name: Среднее время обслуживания и простоя кассы

native.query:
select hour_opened, 
    sum(service_duration_seconds)/sum(check_quantity) as service_time, 
    sum(idle_time_seconds_after_check)/sum(check_quantity) as idle_time
from replset.mv_service_time_by_receipts_detailed
where {{month_of_year}} and 
	{{shop_name}}
group by hour_opened

select hour_opened, sum(check_quantity)/count(distinct report_date) as check_quantity
from replset.mv_service_time_by_receipts_detailed
where {{month_of_year}} and 
	{{shop_name}}
group by hour_opened

select hour_opened, service_category, sum(check_quantity)/count(distinct report_date) as check_quantity
from replset.mv_service_time_by_receipts_detailed
where {{month_of_year}} and 
	{{shop_name}}
group by hour_opened, service_category

select hour_opened, 
	sum(check_sum)/sum(check_quantity) as average_check
from replset.mv_service_time_by_receipts_detailed
where {{month_of_year}} and 
	{{shop_name}}
group by hour_opened

card.name: Средняя выручка в день по часам

from replset.mv_service_time_by_receipts_detailed
where {{month_of_year}} and

select month_year, 
sum(month_profit) / sum(square) as square_efficiency
FROM replset.mv_square_vs_profit_monthly_by_shop
--when {{shop_name}}
group by month_year
order by month_year

select shop_name, 
sum(month_profit) / sum(square) as square_efficiency
FROM replset.mv_square_vs_profit_monthly_by_shop
group by shop_name

select
	report_date,
	shop_name as "Магазин",
	sum(profit_month_to_date) as "Выручка MTD,KZT"
from
	replset.mv_combined_all_stores_data
where
	{{actual_date}}
group by
	report_date,
	shop_name
having
	sum(profit_month_to_date) is not null
order by
	3 asc
limit 5
;

select
	report_date,
	shop_name as "Магазин",
	sum(profit_month_to_date) as "Выручка MTD,KZT"
from
	replset.mv_combined_all_stores_data
where
	{{actual_date}}
group by
	report_date,
	shop_name
having
	sum(profit_month_to_date) is not null
order by
	3 desc
limit 5
;

select discount, sold_qty, vendor_name, total_new_margin_amount
from replset.mvw_promo_analytics
where date_begin > DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)

SELECT promo_name, item_name, discount, sold_qty, new_margin, total_new_margin_amount
FROM replset.mvw_promo_analytics
ORDER BY total_new_margin_amount DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT promo_name,
       sum(total_new_margin_amount) - sum(purchase_compensation) AS net_promo_profit,
       avg(new_margin - old_margin) AS avg_margin_change,
       avg(discount) AS avg_discount
FROM replset.mvw_promo_analytics
where date_begin > DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY promo_name
ORDER BY net_promo_profit DESC;

select vendor_name, TO_CHAR(date_begin, 'YYYY-MM') as month_year,
	sum(total_new_margin_amount) as total_new_margin_amount
from replset.mvw_promo_analytics
where DATE_TRUNC('year', date_begin) = DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY vendor_name, 2;

select vendor_name, 
	sum(total_new_margin_amount) as total_new_margin_amount
from replset.mvw_promo_analytics
where date_begin > DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY vendor_name
order by 2 desc;

select account_code, sum(balance_start_month)
from  replset.mv_month_liquidity
where {{month_of_year}} --ml.month_of_year = '04.2025'
group by account_code
order by account_code

select a.month_of_year, a.assets / p.current_liabilities as liquidity_ratio
from
(select month_of_year, sum(balance_start_month) as assets
from  replset.mv_month_liquidity ml
where ml.account_code in ('1010', '1030', '1050', '1210', '1710')
group by ml.month_of_year) a
left join (select ml.month_of_year, -sum(balance_start_month) as current_liabilities
from replset.mv_month_liquidity ml
where ml.account_code in ('3310')
group by ml.month_of_year
) p
on a.month_of_year = p.month_of_year

where ml.account_code in ('1010', '1030', '1050', '1210', '1710')
group by ml.month_of_year) a
left join (select ml.month_of_year, -sum(balance_start_month) as current_liabilities
from replset.mv_month_liquidity ml
where ml.account_code in ('3310')
group by ml.month_of_year
) p
on a.month_of_year = p.month_of_year 
where (date('01.'||a.month_of_year) >= DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE))
AND
(date('01.'||a.month_of_year) < DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 year')
order by a.month_of_year
